column3: New issue and the comment box own their command id: one per New issue opening and one per comment draft, kept after a network failure or an HTTP-level error so the host's receipt dedupes the retry, and replaced after a success or a definite rejection
column4: review on #42: cmd minted a fresh id per call, so a retry after a lost ack could create a second issue or comment; this mirrors captain.create's dialog
column5: web/src/lib/issues.ts nextCommandId; issues.test.ts; Chromium: a comment whose ack was dropped was retried with the same id and stored once
